Name: B. Ram Narayan
college: PSG Institute of Technology and Applied Research - [PSG iTech]
review:
There are five main events in our college.
1. Advaya ( Inter college festival)
2. Academia conclave ( By industrial Experts)
3. Yuktaha ( National Level Technical Symposium)
4. Sudeva ( Sports Day)
5. Dhaksha (Annual Day)
1. Advaya:
It is an inter college festival. Students from our college participate in the events conducted and they will be showcasing their talents. No matter what, it is one of the beautiful events in the odd semester of that year. There will be a lot of programs for Advaya. It lasts for 2 days and hopefully it's a good event.
2. Academia Conclave It is a conclave conducted by the institution by calling various industrial experts to give a lecture or talk on their point if industrial experience and what they want from students. It lasts for one day with four sessions. It would be quite interesting. It will be in odd semester every very year.
3. Yuktaha
It is a national level Technical Symposium of our college. It lasts for two days. It will be in even semester every year around February. There will be students participating in the events from all over India. People from other colleges are invited and they will be having technical, non technical events. And moreover there will be a stunt show,pro show and many more exciting things that would happen that time. Hope you would know when you see them. 4. Sudeva
Sudeva is our sports day. There will be relay races, 100m Dash and 200m dash. There will be a lot of sports events conducted on and before that day for which the prizes would be given to everyone of them. This is technically the sports day.
5. Dhaksha Dhaksha is our annual day. There will be many cultural events like dance, solondance group dance, music band, solo singing and much more stuffs like skit.
Apart from these very big events there are events for festivals like Onam, Pongal, International women's day, Republic Day, Independence day.The course curriculum is vast and to be frank somethings are not necessary for us to learn. But overall to say, the course structure and plan is good for a student to learn. And when it comes to exams, the exams as of now are conducted by anna university, so this will be quite bad as of now. But when it comes to industrial point learning, our college has various labs for the enhancement of students. Any student can access these labs at any time with prior permission and information. There are no restrictions in this point. So yeah we have a lot of research activities in our college which would definitely help us in getting selected in campus placements. Yearly there will be atleast one industrial visit per class. There may be more than one depending on the willingness of the students. For us we had one but for other departments they might have 2,one in each semester. It would be pretty useful for the students to improve their subject and practical knowledge which would help in campus placements.

Name: Ashank Bekkam
review: The course structure is strongly application based and would benefit those who want to join the work force better. Computer branches have 3 labs a week for 3 hours each, there are 3 full days and 3 half days. The day can often leave you drained, but mostly depends on how your timetable is distributed, which you are NOT allowed to choose on your own. It is allotted at the beginning of each semester. There is a 75% attendance criteria which is easy to maintain but is VERY STRICTLY enforced. Each semester is 4 months long, so there are assignments every other week, if not for assignments, there are lab evaluations or sessional exams. However one does get used to the hectic schedule over time. There Is also a lack of holidays in between, but is made up with a very ( almost excessively long) semester breakSports are top notch. Apart from the standard fields for cricket, football and hockey, the college has an indoor sports complex called marena which comprises of 7 floors. It has a gym, a pool, a futsal court, wooden basketball court tennis, a gym etc. Since manipal has rainy conditions during the odd semester's, many students opt for the indoor complex. Teams exist for all sports on a university and college level. Over 50 clubs, so many that there is internal competition between each of them. There is also a high amount of collaboration and it is very easy to find one of your calling. Nearly every domain has been covered by a club, from film making to public speaking and modeling.. highly recommended

review:
I got admission in this college thourough online counseling process conducted by WBJEE( West Bengal Joint Entrance Examination) Board. Regarding the councelling process :
Students can fill their choices of Stream and College in the descending order of their priority.
For example, a student will fill like
1. CSE in Jadavpur University
2. CSE in Institute of Engineering and Management.
3. ECE in Jadavpur University
.
.
.
This means that student wants the 1st choice first, if not possible then 2nd choice, and so on.
Students are allotted the best possible choice of stream and college according to availability of seat and better rank holder gets the opportunity first to fulfill his /her choice.
After getting the final allocation of stream and college, I went to that college to get admission. I was not interviewed at the time of admission process. I had to submit the fees of 1st semester and other one time charges and fees to complete my admission process.Students are mainly placed in IT companies regardless of stream with an very very good package of 3.5 LPA.
But few students from each batch become able to grab jobs of high salaries(highest package was of 40 LPA offered by Adobe) with their own talent and hardwork mainly thourough off campus placement.
Our college doesn't provide internship. But HODs of each stream help the students to get free internship in different companies and IITs by recommendation. Again, good students are able manage paid internships by their own.

Name: Sheetal Maheshwari

review:
College has never ending list of activities. The major events happening during the entire year is one the freshers party (Abhinandan in the year 2018) for first year (BTech, MTech, PhD, MSC). And the biggest cultural and technical fest in Gujarat is SPARSH which consists of four days and three nights. A sports fest also takes place which is IGNIS (colleges from every corner participate in this event).Every club of the college conducts events during the entire year. The first event of the college is conducted by HINDI CELL during September. events like WOW, SPANDAN, SYNCRONIZE, SYMPHONY, UNPLUGGED, SHAMIYANA happen which are cultural events (dance, music, art, poetry, drama etc.). Inter year sports event also occur. Festival celebrations are also done in the college like Independence Day, Republic Day, Janmasthmi, Lori, holi, Ram-Navmi etc. Hostels also celebrate their own events like sports day, hostel day etc. The college also has a team of NCC made NSS members. Being an NIT certain admission process is to be followed for getting enrolled in this college. Firstly you have to give the entrance exam which is JEE MAINS. If you fulfill the criteria for selection then counselling process starts which is done by JOSAA. In this in the beginning preferences are to be filled since JEE MAINS makes it possible for admission in NITS, IIITs and GFTIs. Counselling process consists of 7 rounds in which seat allocation is done according to your rank in JEE MAINS. Once you get a seat in any of the round you have to go to nearest NIT for the procedure and seat confirmation. Options like Freeze, Float, Slide are available for seat allocation in the counselling.
There is a major benefit in this college which is:- even if you don't get the best branch here which you always wanted but have a will to study hard and get good CGPA then BRANCH CHANGE option is available here. . highly recommended

The classroom is equipped with all the necessary things such as a projector, blackboard, benches, etc. Our campus has one of the best facilities for sports. It has dedicated grounds for all sports and also has gym centres and Olympic size swimming pools. There are many social groups here which include the Finance Club, E-cell (Entrepreneurship club), Drama Club, Film Club, CFI (Centre for Innovation Club) and many more.I chose this course because of my rank and also I was interested in the course of civil engineering. The course curriculum is very well designed where we learn the basics and advanced topics in a span of 4 years. The faculty: student ratio is nearly 1:80. All the faculty members are very well qualified in their respective fields and they all have PhD Degrees. The teaching method is mostly through ppts and something blackboard. One semester works for around 4 months. We have 2 quizzes in between and one end-semester exam at the end which is generally a 20+20+60 breakup. Name: Dhruv Shetty
review:
Well, the course curriculum is great in my college. This is because it is a standard course prepared by GTU ( Gujarat Technological University) and approved by AICTE. So the course build-up is great for a student of any level.
Also, the faculty members are extremely supportive ( not every but most of them) in any difficulty you face.
As I like computers and programming,  so I decided to choose the Computer Engineering branch. Also currently the market for Computer Engineers is pretty large so we have great job opportunities in future compared to other branches.
The faculty: student ratio is also pretty good in my college which is 1:20. Also all the faculties are either pursuing Ph.D. or else have completed a Master's or Ph.D. in the respective subject.
We have 2 exams and 2 vivas each semester. First, we have the mid-sem exam which is conducted by the college and are moderately or easy to pass at least. After that, we have 2 vivas External and Internal. In the end, we have End Semester exam taken by the university.Campus life is great at LDCE. We have all the facilities and amenities needed for perfect college life. The college has a canteen and a Nescafe for refreshments and chilling. We have many grounds and lawns where we can relax in our free time.
We have a huge library that has almost all the books anyone ever needs. Also, all the classrooms are well-equipped and ventilated. For the computer Engineering branch, we have smartboards for better understanding. 
Every year LD has its own Techfest named Lakshya, which is like a festival of 3 days in the college. It contains various activities and events both technical and nontechnical.  Also, there are various clubs in our college like NSS for social service, Prakalpa for innovation, vox populi club for photography, UPSC club for students aiming UPSC, drama club, etc.
Also, almost all the sports are available here and our college's Cricket and Volleyball teams recently won the inter college tournaments too. Hence you can enjoy every sport here.. excellent for placements

Name: Shreya Patel
review:
I had to study something in the commerce field. My first choice was Economics Hons. Failing to get admission for the course in any college of my liking, i made the choice of going for this course.
The present ratio is somewhere around 1:60
Most of the students usually don't attend the classes so, it's really not that big of an issue.
Most of the teachers are decently qualified with masters in various domains and some possess Ph.D. too. However, I do no really find their teaching to be inspiring. They seem more like monotonous renditions. I hope that they taught with more interest and evoked curiosity with their speech. Most of our classes are often canceled. It leads to a lack of interest and seriousness in education.
The exams were fairly easy to navigate as the pattern remains the same and students can easily gauge the repetitions through various sources easily available. A week of serious preparation before the commencement of exams can easily guarantee a student a decent CGPA.Campus Life is pretty decent. I considered it to be great but after I witnessed the same in the other Private Colleges of India, I realized ours doesn't offer us an atmosphere that remotely compares with theirs. 
Our annual fest-Tide is organized in the month of February/March. Then we have other cultural fests that too are sprinkled throughout the year. The major ones take place in Feb/March though.
The library is fairly endowed with a decent number of books.
Classrooms are pretty basic. A blackboard, projector, fans, ventilation, lights- that's pretty much about it.
Sports are actively promoted. Students go up to the nationals while practicing here.
Societies are there too- quite a few. All of them are student-run with a convenor who is a part of the faculty. Enactus, Finance and Investment Cell, Entrepreneurship Cell, Debating Society, Dance Society, and Music Society are among the tons we have here.

Nearly all the faculties are passouts from elite colleges such as IIT Madras, IISc Bangalore, IIT Kharagpur, etc., and hold Ph.D. degrees. Some prefer teaching using presentations while some prefer the old-school method of teaching on board. But we do have received a schedule for the exams, and our mid-semester exams are going to start mid-January, and end-semesters in March.The fee structure somewhere lies between that of prestigious institutions such as IITs and NITs and that of other prestigious institutions such as BITS Pilani. The overall fees for a 4-Year course in BTech are somewhere between 16 to 17 lacs, including hostel and mess charges.
However, there are various opportunities for scholarships as the GP Birla scholarship, where a student has to lie among certain top students of the college in a semester and can get up to 100% scholarship in that particular semester. Other scholarships include ranks in JEE Main examination etc.

There is financial assistance available for students whose parent's annual income is less than 3 lacs per annum.
There aren't any official campus jobs as of yet. However, there are various startups by seniors of the college which provide various tasks such as content writing, prospecting, etc., and one can earn pretty much enough by joining one of them to carry out their monthly expenditures independently.

Name: Utsav Jaiswal
college: SRM Institute of Science and Technology - [SRMIST]
review:
MILAN is an annual fest that is conducted in a huge manner here in around Feb/March. Recently international DJs and actor Nani appeared on the show and it was a huge budget fest. Similarly, Aaruush is a national-level techno-management fest of SRMIST, Kattankulathur. It is one of a kind because it comprises of multi-faceted events ranging from technical to management and sports. Events generally consist of competitions, workshops, speeches by eminent people, etc. It is usually done in October. 
The UB building classrooms are well occupied with foam chairs and joint desks, ACs, and free Wifi but theres no AC case only in Techpark where most of the classes are done. Similarly getting elevators to get to the 11th and 12th floors where your classes are, won't be so easy. It's usually a climb. There are many sports and ECAs done here like hostel level, into college and intercollege teams. DSA is a club here at SRM which holds many domains like data science, web development, music. literature.I chose CSE because it was my subject of interest from the beginning. The student-to-faculty ratio at SRMIST is fairly excellent as there are a lot of faculties for every very domain in the college. However, fitting 70+ students in a class isn't really effective when there's just a single teacher teaching. The class gets out of control quite a few times.
The faculties that teach here are mostly Ph.D. graduates if not just Masters' Degree holders. Their teaching methods are modern and they often use ppt and written notes in order to explain the subject matter the best they can. Although there's just a one-semester term exam, we have Cycle Tests for every subject after every 1-2 unit is completed. They're usually 50-mark tests that account for 7.5 out of the 60 marks of internal evaluation. Passing CTs is very easy but in order to score solid marks, one must push himself a bit forward and work a little hard. The teachers usually don't check the CT paper very strictly, at least in my case.

review: One must give MHT-CET exam and then secure a good rank in merit list. Then he/she should apply for the DTE Mahrashtra CAP rounds in which you need to fill the form of certain details like 12th percentage etc. Then after that DTE declares date on which you need to fill the option form for choices of college as per preference. There are usually 3 DTE rounds with one spot round of DTE and if you wait further, the college may conduct it's own spot round. One needs to be patient during the process. Then you need to visit certain centres (guided by DTE on their website)to authenticate documents. Finally, you need to visit the allotted college and submit documents and pay the fees and get the admission receipt.Don't know about other branches, but for civil engineering, the schedule is hectic. You may feel tired at the end of day since the college time is 9Am-5Pm(you may get free slots in between). The college is not too inclined towards developing research minds in students. Exams are of moderate to high level and labs are something which you can't miss. The laboratory facilities are the worst here.. placement is really good

I selected Muthoot as one of my options and got a seat at this college. After i got a seat i was asked to pay a fee of Rs. 10,000/- to confirm if I was joining the college or not. So I paid the amount and confirmed my seat at the college. Then I was asked to come to college for the admission process. I reached there and they verified all the documents and told me to pay the college tuition fees and some other fees as well which amounted to Rs. 60,000 almost. I chose to pay only one semester fee and pay the rest in the next semester, and yes this option is available and very convenient as well. After this I was asked to wait for the interview with the HOD of the department i had selected which was computer science. So after waiting for a while I was called and he asked me a few questions, such as why i had joined this college, why I selected this course, what are my ultimate goals, and then I answered them and then he asked me if I had any queries about the college and I asked about the sports facilities which are pretty outstanding. And then he welcomed me to this college and said I could leave. And then I started going to classes here.The course curriculum in my opinion is still a bit outdated and way too lengthy and there are many unnecessary and insignificant topics to study. In first year I had to study physics, chemistry, engineering mechanics and many more subjects which I had no interest in and also would not be helpful in increasing my skillset in any manner whatsoever.
The exam structure we have at this college includes a total of 3 Internal exams and one external exam for theory papers. Out of the three internal exam the first 2 have more weightage i.e. 20 marks each and the portions are the 1st and 2nd module for the first internals, and the 3rd and 4th module for the second internals. The third exam is given the least weightage which is just 4 marks. The external exam is conducted by the university and corrected by the same. The practical exams are conducted and evaluated by the college itself. We have continuous evaluation at our university so every lab hour's performance is taken into account and the final lab exam is for 30 marks.. highly recommended. college advertisements are impressive

Name: Neerav Sreekumar
college: IIT Tirupati - Indian Institute of Technology - [IITTP]
review:
The students can start applying for placements in their last year. Many companies including top MNCs visited the campus. IITT doesn't promote the idea of advertising the college through placements, but the placements are actually jaw-dropping for a new college like this. Despite being a 3G IIT, the location plays a crucial role in the placements here. Tirupati is a prime location- 2 hours from Chennai, 3.5 hours from Bangalore, and 6-8 hours from Hyderabad. It has a lot of connections with close institutes like IITM, IISc, CMI, IITH, IIITH, IISERTPT, etc which makes it a must-visit spot for companies and their HR agents. 
The highest package in the year 2021 was nearly 72 lakh, which is insanely high for any new IIT and had overtaken the highest package at IITH and IIT Indore.
In 2022, in phase 1 of the placement, a student from civil engineering got the highest package of nearly 83 LPA, which again was the highest among all the new IITs by a huge margin (IITH had a highest at 63.5 L)I chose Chemicals at IITT because the chemical department here is very excellent at teaching and research. Having IISER Tirupati at a distance of 2 km is another huge benefit to improve the research culture of the college. 
The faculty-student ratio at IITT is the best among all the IITs (5:1). 
All the faculty members are very enthusiastic, young, open to ideas, and Ph.D. graduates either from IISc, IITs, or some university abroad.
IITT follows a continuous evaluation method with 3 exams- Quiz 1, Quiz 2, and End sem. The papers are very normal and scorable too. 
There have been alumni (students) who have gotten into top colleges like Stanford, ETH Zurich, Princeton etc from here too.
The packages here are also really impressive for a 3G IIT. 
This year, after the Phase 1 placement, the highest was 83 LPA, and last year it was around 70 LPA. In both years, IITT had the highest package among all the 3G and the 2G IITs (including IITH and IITI).

and the highest off-campus placement was 1.13 crore given by amazon to 1 student.

review:
NIT Jalandhar, is a premier technical institute located in the city of Jalandhar, Punjab, India. It is knows for its highly qualified and experienced faculty members who came from diverse academic backgrounds and have expertise in various fields of engineering and technology, The institute has a total of 11 academic departments, each headed by a HoD. The exams are known to be challenging, but not excessively difficult. The institute follows a continuous evaluation system to assess the student's performance.The fee structure of NIT Jalandhar varies depending on the program and category of the student. The institute follows a fee structure set by the Ministry of Human Resource Development (MHRD), Government of India. The fee includes tuition fee, hostel fee, and other charges. The institute offers various scholarship opportunities and financial assistance to students to help them meet the cost of their education. The scholarship are provided by the MHRD, state governments, and other agencies. These scholarships are based on the merit, need and income of the family.
In addition to scholarships, the institute also provides interest-free loans to students to help them meet the cost of their education. The load are provided by the banks and other financial institutions and are subject to the terms and conditions of the lending agency.. overall outstanding experience

review:

Based on the rank thus obtained, and the preference list for colleges filled online, a branch is alloted among all of the NITs and other engineering colleges. After that, one has the option to either freeze at that particular branch at the same college, or choose float for a different branch at the same college, or move on to the next round of counselling. All in all there are 7 rounds of counselling, with all thouree options available for the first 6, and the first two options for the last.
Generally all these processes take place over July and August, and I ended up choosing electrical engineering, both because it fascinates me, and also because it is tough for me to sit still for long periods of time, so computer science and electronics ere out of the question.. very supportive faculty

Life on a college campus in India can be exciting and vibrant, providing students with many opportunities for personal and academic growth.

Social life on campus typically revolves around student clubs, organizations, and events. Colleges in India often have a variety of clubs and organizations for students to get involved in, ranging from academic and professional organizations to cultural and recreational clubs. These clubs and organizations provide students with opportunities to meet new people, develop new skills, and pursue their interests outside of the classroom.

The campus infrastructure can also play a big role in shaping the student experience. Well-equipped and well-maintained campuses can provide students with the resources they need to succeed academically and thrive socially. This may include modern classrooms and laboratories, libraries, student centers, sports facilities, and more.

Of course, the quality of campus life can vary greatly depending on the institution, sThe fees structure of colleges in India can vary greatly depending on the institution and the program you are interested in. Some colleges, such as government-funded institutions, may have lower fees, while private institutions may charge significantly higher fees. Additionally, fees for certain programs, such as engineering or medicine, may be higher due to the cost of laboratory equipment, facilities, and other resources required for the program.

When it comes to scholarships, financial assistance, and campus jobs, the availability and terms can vary greatly depending on the institution and program. Some colleges may have a limited number of scholarships available for students who demonstrate financial need or academic excellence. Others may offer loans or other forms of financial assistance to help students meet their expenses.

Campus jobs, such as teaching assistantships, research assistantships, or work-study programs, may also be available to students in some institutions. Thes. one of the best colleges

review: The campus of this college is very clean as well as green and culturally diverse. We are allowed to learn a lot of things from different people around the world as well as in India. Sarang is the college's annual fest, and shastra is a technological fest conducted by computer science students, where we can get to show off our innovative ideas. The library of this college is among the largest in the country, with many books available from all over the world from various authors and writers. The college library also has research journals. The research facilities are modern and outfitted with a wide range of research tools. The lab has approx 100 PCs and is fully wifies with 24 hours service available. In short, we can say that the college's infrastructure is in good condition.The fees for this course are rs 1 lakh per semester and Rs 2 lakh per year which includes the tution fees only. We can clear all the fees to spend on our studies with the help of good placements provided by this college. The scholarship in this college is available on the basis of merit and financial need through schemes like institute merit - cum - means scholarships, institute free studentship, institute national prize, and SC/ST scholarships. Apart from these, this college does not provide any further scholarships to the students but this college will help you to take maximum benefits from the scholarships provided by the local government. If you want to take benefits, then you can fill out and submit your form on the college premises, and this college will further submit your form to the government.

The tie-up with IBM and Samatrix for the specialization chosen was the reason I chose the course.

Also, the Wi-Fi speeds across campus are just atrocious, to say the least with speeds reaching a maximum of 7-12 Mbps. The availability of books pertaining to Ai and ML is virtually absent.

review:

Alongside these annual events, we've many events on the way, they are randomly occuring events which provide exposure to the students, also there are many clubs which are being operated by students in the college, these are dancing club, singing club, literature club etc. These people conduct auditions for the freshers and give them entry to their respective clubs. They compete on national level platforms.My college has semester pattern for B.Tech, each semester is of 6 months, there are total 8 semesters, that is, 4 years of Engineering. In each semester there are 5 to 7 subjects which we need to study out of which 5 are the necessary ones, that makes 40 different subjects in 4 years! In the first year, students in all the branches(CS, IT, Electical etc.) have the same subjects which they're required to study, afterwards they have to study subjects related to their respective branches. During each semester, we face 4 exams of all the subjets of that semester, 3 mid-semester exams(called midsems) and 1 end-semester exam(called endsem), the 3 midsems are 30 marks exams each, which we face during the 2nd, 3rd and 5th month respectively, out of these 3, the one in which our performance was best is selected and its marks are carried forward. Then comes the endsem exams which decide if we're going to pass that semester or not, they're 105 marks exams held on the 6th month of that semester, the pass marks are 33 for endsem.

Weekly activities can offer a welcome break from studies and homework — particularly for senior students if they can spare the time. Depending on your child’s interests, they may provide the chance to get outside and exercise, see friends, pursue a hobby or simply destress and refresh their mind. They also help limit the time your child is spending in front of a TV or computer screen. They can help your child build their skills outside of the classroom
In addition to building skills within a specific discipline, extracurricular activities are great for developing general academic and soft skills. Think debating for public speaking, academic competitions for exam strategies and sport for teamwork. Balancing a number of commitments can help to improve your child’s time management skills, while finding an area they enjoy or excel at can boost self-confidence. They can open your child’s mind to new interests (and views)
While students usually have the opportunity to pursue a wide range of study areas through core subjects and electives, extracurricular activities allow students to explore an interest in more depth than what is covered in class — or maybe even find a completely new interest that they wouldn’t have been exposed to otherwise. They can also provide a great chance for students to broaden their perspective of the world, particularly those involved in volunteering and community service programs.I have submitted the online application form and the mark of CET I get admission in MIT ADT University Admissions officers review and make decisions on hundreds, sometimes thousands, of applications in a short period of time. They are under enormous pressure to assess the applicant pool in order to produce the best class and the best campus community possible. How you apply, when you apply, and what you say can all impact whether you receive an acceptance or a denial. What factors in to the increasingly selective college application process?
What Matters Most
A student’s record in and outside the high school classroom demonstrates to an admissions officer the kind of contributions he or she will make at the college level. Colleges are looking for candidates who perform consistently well or show a record of improvement in rigorous or college-prep courses. This means the right coursework, good grades, and activities that have a positive impact should be a continuous focus throughout high school.

Name: Justin Jenish
college: SRM Institute of Science and Technology - [SRMIST]
review:
I got my admission through the SRM entrance which I attended in Bangalore. After the results were out, according to the rank segment you belong to, you're invited to a counseling session at a certain campus on specific dates. I had ktr as my counseling centre. On the day of counseling, all the students gathered will be allowed to view all courses available and how many seats are vacant for each course in each campus. While you view this and remain seated, according to your ranks, you're called to submit your certificates for verification, application form, etc along with a DD of your annual fees and also have a small interview with the staff at the desk. Followed by this, along with one parent, you're directed to a hall of staffs with computers where you can approach any who are free and tell them which course you wish to opt and which campus. They will check the availability of seats immediately and if its available, in the next 3-5 minutes you're allotted a seat and you recieve a printed statement of your course, fee structure etc. With this your seat is confirmed. Later, on the mentioned dates, you are to visit the campus opted and submit your certificates, fill up a few forms and other formality to make it clear that you will definitely be joining the college. This aside, if you require hostel, you fill other forms and apply for it. I had not taken hostel and so I cannot give a very detailed guide to how it works, but I know it's very simple and one just has to submit an application along with a DD of the hostel fees.
I chose SRM because being a private institution, it has certain merits and better placement options. They had CSE with specialization introduced for the first time which back then was only available at SRM. There were many specializations such as cloud computing, cyber security, internet if things, artificial intelligence and machine learning, etc. I chose Big Data Analytics and my campus choice was Ramapuram which I'm certain of and supported by most that's its the best place for discipline and education quality unlike the other campuses where events and ither programs unrelated to the course are given priority and overall has a bad reputation for performance in exams. I'm happy with my choice of campus and course and would recommend it to anyone who wishes to complete the course well than have fun all the time considering its college.I do like the teaching quality. Of course I'm not saying all teachers are very excellent but most are impressive and have a lot of knowledge beyond what the course requires. Our subjects and its contents and curriculum fortunately are industry based unlike some colleges and their curriculum which just follow traditional engineering books and nothing more. We're taught what's really required and what's currently going on in industry rather than pointless topics which were once a part of traditional engineering. The course has additional subjects, some of them purely aimed at improving students in their physical and mental health such as yoga, critical thinking and creativity, soft skills, history and civics, evs, etc. One additional subject I greatly valued is foreign languages, all students must compulsorily study any of the various choices of foreign language. I chose German and they trained me upto the requirement to write the official German exam. Research opportunities are there and all support is provided to those who are innovative and prove themselves worthy. Placement training starts from first semester, providing us knowledge and practice of right etiquette, communication skills,coding skills, etc. Industry visits are held. As of now, as a 2nd year I haven't had one but my seniors have had and hopefully the same will be provided to us. They provide opportunities to continue your studies outside as well be exchange students or complete half your btech in a foreign university provided you have the required communication skills and cgpa and financing. highly recommended

We don’t mean to toot our own horn, but—beep beep—we have everything you need to find the perfect college. No, really. It’s like having your own fancy private college admission advisor. Except, you know, free. Now, before you dive into your college search, you may be tempted to just skim the subheads below and make sense of these college search steps on your own. But that won’t be enough to really help you. And, believe us, you do not want to take a shortcut through your college search. Instead, go through all of these helpful articles, because if you follow the advice inside, your college search will get way easier. An important note about college costs: We'll get to financial aid in a minute. But as you're figuring out your college search criteria, it's often best to leave cost out of it. Just ignore the "sticker price. " Not that cost won't be a factor—it obviously is—but your goal right now is to find colleges that really and truly fit you. Academic fit. Social fit. Career prep fit. All the fits. Because, when a school is the right fit for you, the financial aid tends to fall into place. And, believe us, financial aid changes everything. (In fact, you might find that the fancy private school that seemed out of reach is actually your most affordable option, once you get their financial aid award letter. ) Eventually, you'll have a spreadsheet (or two) listing out the college tuition and other costs for all your schools, along with the financial aid package they awarded you. You'll have lots of research and data points to look at when making your final college choice, a choice you and your family can afford. You're not there yet, but you will be.Teachers may also use the term “curriculum” to refer to the actual information they teach throughout a class. For example, a teacher may say, “This paper shows the curriculum for my introduction to health science course. ”
Teachers may also search the Internet or ask their colleagues for “more curriculum, ” which means the teacher is looking for more resources to use in a classroom setting. For example, a teacher may ask, “Where can I get more curriculum to fill my Microsoft class?”
Finally, a school, institution, or district can refer to their standards or class sequence as “curriculum. ”
For example, an administrator may declare, “Our career readiness curriculum includes the newest and most cutting-edge skills that employers require in new hires. ”
With that in mind, your standard curriculum typically consists of the following parts:
Purpose Statement: What will this curriculum achieve?
Outcome Statement: What will students be able to do with this information?
Essential Resources: What will you use to teach your class and what will students use to learn.

review:

The lack of proper communication about whether a professor would be there to take a lecture or not was absolutely unacceptable. Students waited for upwards of 45 minutes for a lecturer to walk in and start the class. If a lecturer didn't walk into the class within the first 10 minutes of the allotted time, the students should be dismissed and attendance for that lecture must be given. Also, the normalization of taking digital notes should be made common since it doesn't make sense to take handwritten notes for subjects like Computer Science which only has code (the same must apply to exams too)
The exam schedule came in extremely late which was two days before it was supposed to begin which is unacceptable.There are mixed feelings about the aspect of campus life. Also, the Wi-Fi speeds across campus are just atrocious, to say the least with speeds reaching a maximum of 7-12 Mbps. The availability of books pertaining to Ai and ML is virtually absent.
Sports facilities are sufficient across campus. As far as I know, there is no website run by students.. overall outstanding experience

Name: Rythm Gupta
college: IIT Delhi - Indian Institute of Technology [IITD]
review:
Fees for general category students in IIT are 1,66,500(including mess, hostel, and other fees) per semester. So fees are roughly 3 lac per year with slight variations of around 10k-20k in other IITs.

If you are SC/ST cat. the student then your fees are around 18k-20k per semester or even less. You will also get a scholarship of 1000 per month from Institute no matter what your family income is.

If you are a gen/OBC cat. a student with a family income less than 5 lac/annum, your 2/3rd fees will be waived off.

If your family income is less than 1 lac/annum, full fees will be waived. Moreover, you will be provided financial support from Institute.

P. S. Banks will give loans up to 5 lac without interest, without any guarantee for all IIT, NIT students no matter what their financial background is. You can even avail loan of up to 9 lac and its interest will be paid by Institute, you just need to pay money. So, don't worry about fees, all things will take care of and aid will be providedIITD has the smallest campus at around 320 acres, but on the plus side, it's bang in the middle of Delhi. The campus doesn’t feel small though. On my first day here, I was totally blown away by the sheer size of it.

The academic area is pretty decent, and I really like the Bharti Building, and in particular the GCL (General Computing Lab), which is like a second home for our department. The classrooms vary from huge comfy AC-equipped to antique stuffy ones.

The studies are no cakewalk - this is an IIT after all. And you'll come to get exasperated with the multitude of exams: two minors, one major. So mostly you'll be dreading, preparing, or giving exams throughout the semester. Not to mention quizzes, assignments, practicals, etc. Your mileage with marks may vary, but it's not extremely hard to scrape through most courses.
The quality of faculty varies, but CS profs are thankfully comparatively chill. Overall though, IMHO, the faculty could be better

Renu shrivastava who is the best teacher in the field of communication, she works their as a team of placement department.Placements in our college are good. About 75% of the students got internships. The college has its own hospital, and many of my seniors are working there. The stipend offered during an internship is not too high. Selections for PG are quite good. But since this is a medical college, no need to worry much about placements.

Name: Suman kumari
review: Teachers are extremely helpful, both on campus and off campus. Faculties here are highly educated and knowledgeable. They show a lot of support. For important decisions, technical conferences were held several times in the seminar hall with a pannel of HODS and specialists of the field present. The course is relevant to the industry and with this, we all need to learn different skills which will make us industry ready.  Semester exams are easy, however, due to changes in Universities' rules and regulations, exams are sometimes tough. Class tests and mick tests are conducted on regular basis to keep. Students engaged and prepared for their papersAll facilities like wifi, library, different playgrounds and courts for different sports activities, water and current supply for 24×7. Classrooms are well equipped with technical equipment. Different sports activities are organised to keep students fit and active, cultural events occur every very year where sometimes either a great representative of MNC comes and address us or sometimes we have celebrities there who make student excited. There are different clubs for technical, management, co-curricular activities and many more where students are engaged to perform certain projects on their topics given.. placement is really good

Name: Saurabh Agarwal
college: Arya College of Engineering & Research Centre - [ACERC]
review: Why I choose this course because I have interest in this field I love programming languages and I love technologies and I want to work in mega tech companies that's why I choose this stream. Faculty are well educated most of the faculty have doctorate degree student and faculty ratio there are 60 strength of class on one teacher. Midterm exams are on time they are not hard you can easily attempt if you pay attention in your class there are two midterm exam in one semester.Arya is known for their placements placements are not so excellent but average you will get placement in your 6th semester there are lot of companies like TCS and other mass recruiters companies will pick you in your 6 semester with an average package. Most of highest package are off campus if if you want a highest package then you can go for off campus. Most of the student get placed. I will also try off campus for good package.. highly recommended

Name: Aditya Singh
review: The course is basically about economics and its parts it includes subjects like statistics, mathematics, micro and macroeconomics and econometrics. Faculty members include professors and assistant professors. The qualification of the teachers is that they have PhDs. Due to the delay in the admission process, it was difficult to cover the course and was difficult to passLife on the campus is very good and you get to learn about a lot of curricular activities also you can look for talents within yourself. There are annual fests going on in the months of march -April. There are also a lot of societies in which you can enrol yourself and learn a lot of things in various fields such as marketing, technology etc.. overall outstanding experience

Name: Abhishek Singh
review:
Freshers are organized in our college every year.
Innotech, Epox is our annual fest organized every year.
Almost all the books and journals are available in our library.
In our college sports activities is very smooth running. Every year our college organized sports events.
All the amenities are excellent in our classroom.
There are many clubs in my college like mycin, mosaic,fossc, did, and more to provide the platform to explore knowledge and exposure.Amazon, Capgemini, and many more companies allow doing an internship in that company and give the role under internship with a stipend.  
Mobile robots, electronic vehicles, and many projects allow the students to explore and learn the skill about the particular field they choose.. highly recommended

Name: Hansika
college: IIT Delhi - Indian Institute of Technology [IITD]
review: I chose chemical engineering because I am interested in courses that involve the environment and on researching, I got to know that there's a huge scope for chemical engineering in the future. The faculty are really excellent and have graduated from one of the top schools in the world such as oxford, MIT, etc. The exams are conducted once every very 2 months and they are quite difficult to pass.There are lots of clubs available and lots of opportunities such as dance, music, art, quizzing, fashion, literature, and whatnot! There are also social groups to prevent discrimination on any basis be it sexuality or caste. A huge library is available for both academic and nonacademic purposes. All kinds of sports stadiums are available.. highly recommended. many students give positive feedback online

Name: RAMAKRISHNA BENDALAM
college: Sathyabama Institute of Science and Technology
review: There are total of 2 semesters for each year of course. Each semester has its two mid exams of each 50 marks which later converted into 20 marks that contributes 40 marks with 10 marks for attendance and assignments. Atlast 40+10 total 50 internal marks and the semester exam conducted for 100 marks contributes 50 marks. Therefore 50 internals +50 semester gives 100 marks.Hostel fee is to be paid in excess of the fee mentioned above, i. e, Rs. 80,000/- per year and AC hostel Fee is 175000/- per year. Hostel facility will be allocated on First Come and First Serve basis. As everyone of us know the water scarcity in chennai due to which the hostel students recieves water only 1hr per day.

Name: Abhijeet
review: It was different from other courses as it offered MBA in Information Technology Business Management. I chose Information security as my specialization. The student ratio is very good. Almost all the faculties have a Ph.D. or are pursuing it. Exams are not that difficult to pass.5 to 10% fee hike every year. No scholarship was provided. Financial Assistance in terms of education loans at lower interest rates is available. 100% placements. 12LPA average CTC. BIG 4 visits every year for final placements. All students get summer internships.. overall outstanding experience. placement claims look very attractive

Name: thirukoovela abhilash
review: The technical fest AVAZYA is conducted every year. Eureka is another fest for freshers which encourages juniors. They are conducted during the months of December, March, and April. The library is very large and it is a excellent platform to achieve anything. It contains almost every journal released every month. The classroom contains good benches, fans, lights, and a projector. Our college is good at encouraging sports. The grounds are well maintained. There is a club called NSS which is run by studentsI was very interested in electronics and I am good at physics and interested to learn. This course is a core to good into good placements. The faculty-student ratio is very good compared to other colleges. The ratio is 1:25.Almost all are well qualified and completed their degrees from universities and iit's. The teaching method is based on wit and will. The exams are every month. The exams are at moderate levels.

Name: Asfaq Jalal
college: IIT Madras - Indian Institute of Technology - [IITM]
review: I chose B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering because it was one of my main interests as a core field and also I liked the curriculum of the same at IIT Madras. All faculty are well-qualified and experienced. There are usually 3 exams per semester and they're not tough to pass.There are so many fests like Shaastra, Saarang, E-Summit, Samanvay, and many more. The library is filled with so many books in all fields. All classrooms are equipped with good facilities. There are many clubs run by students like CFI, E-Cell, etc.. very supportive faculty

Name: Swarnima
college: Indira Gandhi Delhi Technical University For Women -[IGDTUW]
review: The annual cultural fest is Taarangana. It is conducted in Feb. or April. Annual tech fest is innerved. It is conducted in the month of October. The classroom is not that excellent, the desks are old. Although they have projector facility. There is a sports society named Synergy. Which conducts an annual sports fest named Ignite. It has good volleyball, football, table tennis, and badminton, teams. There is a very good website named IGDTUW RESOURCES which is made by seniors and is very beneficial. There is a fee exemption for the general EWS candidates who scored maximum in JEE mains in their respective branches. Also, the university provides many other scholarships. The college provides internship opportunities. A fee hike policy is also there.. placement is really good. college advertisements are impressive

Name: Rudra Chaudhari
review: There are many opportunities in computer engineering. The teachers are excellent and approachable. The teaching is satisfactory. TCS, Infosys, Wipro, Accenture, etc., are the top recruiting companies. The average salary package offered ranges from 3 LPA - 4 LPA. The highest salary package offered ranges between 8 LPA to 17 LPA.

Name: Tanya moghe
college: Bharati Vidyapeeth's College  of Engineering - [BVCOE] Lavale
review: I couldn't score well in JEE so to get out of disappointment and grab the best I could get I decided to give bvp enterance exam called BVPCET which was held In may end.Then I was called for the couselling as per the merit number and was alloted with branch of my choice.To get into branch of your choice you need to score in top 500 merit no.As CS IT and other top branches close after merit no.500.At the time of couselling you need to submit a DD of college fee if you want to book the seat.For the exam BVPCET.You need to study 11th 12th physics, chemistry, maths.There will be basic questions in each section which will test your basic knowledge.Total time for the exam will be 3 hrs.And the plus point is that there is no negative marking so you can attempt all the questions. very supportive faculty

Name: Praful Shankar Borkar
review:
In rie Bhopal inter-house competitions, as well as inter riesm, were conducted every year. 
Cultural and literary activities and festivals are organised every month.
The availability of books and journals in the library is best. Rie's library is known as the best library in Bhopal.
Football, volleyball, cricket, etc games are conducted by the sports department, as well as NSS and NCC, which are available for extra curricular activities on campus.
Red ribbon club nss and so the social groups as well as club are run by rie students.The overall course is divided into 8 semesters for four years integrated course and 4 semesters for B Ed and M.Ed course

The colleges of different states are comes to higher teachers as per the 20k to 45k per month packages.
100 per cent placement is given to students.
After getting my degree I completed my M.Ed.. very supportive faculty

Name: Dishant chourasia
college: IIT BHU - Indian Institute of Technology
review:
The events celebrated in our college are-:
1. Codefest - this is our coding fest which is conducted online and has a variety of competitions which includes competitive programming , machine learning , app development , capture the flag and etc.
2. Aagman- this fest is for freshers in which they showcase their talent in field of dancing, indian music, western music, drama, debates ,poetries etc.
3.Spardha- this is one of the biggest games and sports fest of india.
Students from all over india come to participate in a number of sports competition which goes on for 3 days including cricket, hockey , badminton, basketball, tennis,football and a lot more. We have dj nights as well.
4. Texhnex- this is our technical fest which brings a lot of participation form students all over the country in various competitons like drone making, line crawler , water powered crane models , water rocket, airplane models and a lot.
Each day ends with either a dj night or some other entertaining event such as a stand up comedy or music show.
This year , KK was invited to perform in technex music show which was held in night.
5.kashiyatra-. This is our cultural fest which holds a number of competition like solo dance , duo dance , group dance , music in all three categories and drama.
There are events like debates , poetries, roastings and a lot more.Course curriculum is very diverse andi think that is important.
I m a computer science student currently in my 2nd year. In my first year , I studied physics,biology ,maths 1 and 2 ,humanities and engineering drawing too which have nothing to do with my department but are essential for knowledge of an engineer.
I also had C programming , linux and Python courses , data structures wHich are my departmental courses.
In every semester, for every subject there are 2 quizzes, 2 or more assignments ,mid term and an end term written examination.
Some subjects have labs as well and in labs which are held every week , there are experiments , viva and lab records have to be maintained.. placement claims look very attractive

Name: Adarsh Singh
college: G L Bajaj Institute of Technology and Management
review:
Teaching quality is excellent they conduct internal exams frequently in preparation for university exams, also provide separate classes for technical training and work on weak students. 
The teachers in our institution are very helpful, well qualified, and have good knowledge.This college has a Microsoft innovation center where every student gets the best opportunities to explore their own knowledge in this collage 5 startup company works that will provide internships to a student with good stipends.

Name: Parth Deep Matta
review: The course curriculum has been played out such that the topics are covered from complete basics. The mode of teaching is usually from certain prescribed textbooks and ppts prepared by the faculty. But in order to get the in-depth knowledge of the subject, the student must to self study and go for few topics beyond the scope of syllabus. The Exam structure is what I feel is a little not planed properly. There are 2 mid semester exams in which we get 3 compulsory 2 mark questions and 2 out of 3 optional 15 marks question. The total marks is 36. Duration 1 hour. And for the final exam is 3 hours, 5, 2 marks questions and rest 10 marks question, 2 from all the 3 sections.The placement drive held in our college is very vast and a lot of companies from all over the country visit the campus. But unfortunately the scope of my course us limited and the companies directly Core to our field are very less. The students did get placed in companies like, indigo airlines, stipend around 5LPA. Coming to internships, yes we have a lot of opportunities for that as the faculty is supported in that area. We can approach the faculty with a internship plan for company and they are willing to grant the permission along with the letter of recommendation.. management promotes the college heavily

Name: Veerababu
review: Many companies are tie up with Aditya Engineering College and they conduct interviews to recruit the students.From third year of engineering study,we are eligible for the interviews.when we didn't get any placement then we can try in offcampus.In Aditya Engineering College,there is good environment and mangement will always develop the infrastructure.There are many clubs for sports,cultural activities and social activities.Students can choose any club to participate.. management promotes the college heavily

Name: Vinit Jawali
college: Drs. Kiran and Pallavi Patel Global University
review: Every year to maintain the physical health of the student's sports week is conducted and it consists of all sports including cricket, football, basketball, volleyball, Kabbadi, etc. Even traditional games are also conducted like Satodiyu, lemon and spoon race. An online process of selection is done and as per cut-off and selection, we got selected into the college. After that, a print out of that selected list is then submitted to the college by bus and then submitting the fees.. one of the best colleges

Name: Student (Anonymous)
review: Placements are excellent. More than 900 multinational companies visited the CU campus in 2022 and the highest international package offered is 1.7cr   and the very good package lies between 4lakh-5lakh per annum. Companies such as Microsoft, Deloitte, IBM, and Flipkart visited Cu every year. Overall placements are better as compared to other private universities.My time fee is 90k per semester but this year there is a hike in fees and it's around 1.06k per semester. You can give a scholarship test (CUCET EXAM) and score as much as you can. It's an online test and it's based on the 11th and 12th syllabus. Scholarships are also given based on your jee mains or 12th score.

Name: Anupam Vishwakarma
review: The overall campus life is excellent for students and faculty.  Every year in the month of April a cultural fest is done where different types of dance, sports activities, etc. are done. The classroom is well-equipped with lights and fans. There is also a library where all course books are available and also some story books are available. There are also many clubs such as sports, cultural, and tech clubs.The students get placement in the last year of the course and for the internship, they can apply for the 4 semesters. The company that visited during campus are Mankind, Cipla, etc. About 20% of students get placed. The highest package was 10L and the average was 5L. The college provides internships in other cities also.. very supportive faculty. many students give positive feedback online

Tenacious (gaming, gdsc(coding), etc, etc.. best college experience. many students give positive feedback online

review: This field is the best in this University..there are soo many sports and clubs to choose from there is football, cricket, basketball, volleyball, kabbadi, literally every main sport is here..and soo many students participate also..there are many clubs as well..from management to coding to graphic designing etc.From the 3rd-semester students start to get internship opportunities. Name: Om Mishra
review:
A Technical and Cultural fest is organized in the institute every year - CORONA and MILANGE at around December. An annual fest, ECCENTRICA is also organized every year around October. Apart from these, many other festivals are enjoyed by students which are organized by different clubs.
The library includes all the books necessary during the course for every year, every branch. Journals and newpapers are also available in the latest editions.
Most of the classrooms are smart classes with projectors, screens, and microphones. All the classes have Air Conditioning and excellent ventilation.
Cricket, Football, Badminton, and other games are played on campus and students participate in different games in Inter-NIT sports meet. There is also a gym, music room, badminton court, and cafeteria to enjoy and chill.
NSS has a branch in NIT Patna that is run by the students themselves. There are many clubs robotics, coding, entrepreneurship etc.Mechanical engineering opens a gate for a number of opportunities that include GATE, PSUs, Indian Engineering Services, and many other government services. Students can also go for private companies.
The faculty-student ratio in NIT Patna is around 1:20. There are adequate faculty members in the college.
All of the professors and assistant professors have done Ph.D. from prestigious institutes around the world. Most of the faculty members have good teaching skills, but some of them are still preferring the years-old method of memorization which sometimes feels quite boring.
Exams are held two times in a semester, Mid-sem and End-sem. Class tests are also taken occasionally. Passing the semester exams are very easy, But maintaing a good CGPA is not so easy.

Name: Vedant Garg
review:
The university hosts an annual cultural fest, Moksha, and a technical fest, Innovision, which are conducted in the months of February and October, respectively. These fests provide a platform for students to showcase their talents and participate in various competitions and events. The university has a well-stocked library that is open to students throughout the week and provides a peaceful and conducive environment for studying.
The classrooms, labs and computer centre at NSUT are well-equipped with modern amenities, including projectors, Wi-Fi, and air-conditioning, providing a comfortable learning experience for students. The campus of NSUT provides various sports and extracurricular activities for students, including football, basketball, badminton, and cricket and the university has a dedicated sports complex. There are also various social groups and clubs run by students, including the Robotics Club, the Literary Society, and the Entrepreneurship Club.The fee structure for BTECH in Information Technology with a specialization in Network and Information Security at Netaji Subhas University of Technology, Delhi, is reasonable and is subject to revision by the university from time to time. The cost to study includes tuition fees, examination fees, library fees, and other miscellaneous fees.
The university offers several scholarships and financial assistance programs to deserving students based on their academic performance and financial needs. Some of the popular scholarships include the NSUT Merit Scholarship, NSUT Merit-cum-Means Scholarship, NSUT Minority Scholarship, and NSUT Sports Scholarship. The university also offers various campus jobs, including research assistantships, teaching assistantships, and lab assistantships, which provide students with hands-on experience and a stipend. Overall, NSUT provides several opportunities for students to receive financial assistance and secure on-campus jobs.

Name: Rick Roy

. overall outstanding experience. placement claims look very attractive
